title: Leafy Sea Dragon
subtitle: Prehensile Tail Spiral & Foliaceous Camouflage
description: Phycodurus eques syngnathid anatomy displaying an armored tubular pipe snout, an Archimedean/logarithmic prehensile tail curl, and undulating leafy camouflage lobes.
mathNotation: r_{\text{tail}}(\theta) = r_0 e^{-b \theta}, \quad \mathbf{p}_{\text{leaf}}(s, t) = \mathbf{p}_{\text{stem}}(s) + \begin{bmatrix} A_s \sin(\omega_s t + s) \\ A_s \cos(\omega_s t + s) \end{bmatrix}
formulaCompact: tail = tail_root + [35 - cos(θ)*r, 25 + sin(θ)*r],  r = 55 * exp(-0.45*θ),  leaf_sway = sin(2.5t + phase)*14
